propositions: During each outbound reconcile pass, per-project effective config resolution via config.effective_* is called once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem discovery and overlay resolution work.

A pass-scoped dict cache keyed by (axis, project_key) will memoize config.effective_* results within a single compute_outbound_mutations call, reducing N redundant resolutions to M (one per distinct project).

The memoization cache must be threaded as an optional parameter through compute_outbound_mutations, the per-ticket consumer functions, and the six _effective_*_for helpers without adding conditional branches to existing functions.
Emitted mutations and per-project effective config values must remain identical after memoization is applied, with each ticket's mutation reflecting its own project's overlay.
The cache is fresh per pass (created as a local variable in compute_outbound_mutations) to prevent config staleness across multiple passes or tests.
